features.description: test_coverage rigor bundle — v4 D009 + recurring D007 pattern close. Three concrete fixture-rigor findings banked across the v3/v4 closeouts; the codex auditor flagged them consistently, the implementer addressed each one's narrow scope, but each finding's deeper integration shape was deferred to v4.1. (a) v3/v4 D007: test_verdict_blocked_reconciliation_f002.py:540-586 uses permissive `audit_status not in {blocked, blocked_no_findings, stopped_environmental_blocker}` — auditor wants strict `== needs_changes`. (b) v3 F002 D007 #2: Plan 010 F002 fixture is hand-coded synthetic data rather than replaying the actual saved codex envelope. (c) v4 F003 D009: Plan 004 F002 reproducer exercises _apply_target_accountability + per-command shlex wrapper but not the full dispatch_volley terminal path with parse-breaking input. Each is a quality-of-tests upgrade, not a correctness defect. Recurrence across 3 features in a row = worth one batched discharge rather than letting it cluster again.
steps: Locate the v4 F002 fixture at test_verdict_blocked_reconciliation_f002.py:540-586. Replace the permissive `not in {blocked, blocked_no_findings, stopped_environmental_blocker}` assertion with strict `assert result.terminal_status == "needs_changes"`. Adjust the fixture setup if the strict assertion uncovers no-progress / diminishing-returns paths that demand a richer fixture (in which case widen the fixture, not the assertion).

Identify the Plan 010 F002 hand-coded fixture in test_verdict_blocked_reconciliation_f002.py. Replace the hand-coded findings list with a json.load() of the on-disk envelope at docs/plans/2026-05-10-001-feat-printing-press-adapter-skill/audit/codex-auditor-F002-i0.json — same way v4 F003 iter1 replaced fabricated commands with the real envelope.

In test_shlex_safe_command_guard_f003.py, add a new test (`test_plan_004_f002_replay_full_dispatch_volley_reaches_clean_terminal`) that calls supervisor.dispatch_volley with mocked executors that return the Plan 004 F002 reproducer envelope (parse-breaking input), and asserts the function returns a VolleyResult with terminal_status in the accepted-terminal set ({signed_off, needs_changes, blocked, blocked_no_findings}) rather than raising or hanging. Mock both implementer + auditor executors to avoid live API calls.

Run the three targeted fixture modules (test_verdict_blocked_reconciliation_f002.py + test_shlex_safe_command_guard_f003.py) + full orchestrate sweep. Sweep must stay ≥1928 green; the three modules above should add at least 2-3 net new test functions.
